title: Home practical guide and safety card: kitchen fair test
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Changes of materials and animals including humans
source: Written for science/y5 lesson 23 (Home practical guide and safety card: kitchen fair test (portal worksheet; warm tap water only, adult present))
intro: Lesson 23: Kitchen chemistry: a fair test on one change. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To carry out a fair test on one kitchen change
safety: Warm tap water only, adult present
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Choose one question, for example: does warm water dissolve sugar faster?
Change only the water temperature; keep the amount of sugar, water and stirring the same
Drop one sugar cube in each glass and start the timer
Repeat and work out which is faster

questions.q: Big question: how could you prove warm water dissolves sugar faster?
questions.a: Time both with the same sugar, water amount and stirring; the shorter time shows which is faster.
